POV: you find a $10-and-under café on a quiet Phu Quoc street and suddenly your whole day slows down.

58 CAFÉ on Hoàng Văn Thụ is that place. 4.5 stars, 130 reviews, and the kind of vibe that makes you cancel your afternoon plans.

No resort markup. No tourist trap. Just good coffee at a price that makes sense.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
